name: MQTT broker source connector for Eventstream
description: Eventstream now offers a generally available MQTT broker source connector, enabling ingestion from MQTT-based devices and brokers. MQTT is common in Internet of Things scenarios, and this connector brings that telemetry into Microsoft Fabric for real-time analytics.With this capability, you can:- Connect Eventstream to MQTT brokers and devices.- Stream device telemetry into Fabric destinations.- Process and route MQTT events with no-code operators or SQL operators.
